new_written_arguments: A proper algebraic map with only isolated critical points and a holomorphic top form has subpolar finite Cauchy-period branches for every compact middle cycle:regular compact portions are analytic,and local thimble/tube terms obey the imported local bounds plus the explicit relative resolution estimate.

For any polynomialp,finite root traces preserve the subpolar bound under ramification. A rational Cauchy infinity germ is then zero,so eventual moments force zeroth volume0. No reality of the seed is needed.

For an affine quadric Q_N and minimal polynomial degreeD,the closed graphH=t*u^D in the projective quadric timesA1 is proper. A smooth leading divisor gives smooth coordinatesv=t*u^D and a submersion at infinity. The residue volume changes fromu^-N to u^(D-N);D>=N makes it holomorphic. The affine critical locus has no positive-dimensional proper components,hence is finite.

Apply to SL2 upstairs,dimension3:every nonzero pure exceptional phase has a singular leading O(D,D) divisor on the projective rank-one quadric,using the original minima8/12. This includes full non-T-invariant and image-interior phases,without classifying their singular-leading locus.

Coprime right invariant pairs in degrees24k/60k and the complete left degreeD system have nonempty smooth leading strata. A direct singular-incidence argument treats the finite right ramification set separately;finite averaging lifts all invariant Segre sections to actual leading polynomials.

The real harmonic sphere seeds hO degree4 and hI degree6 have squarefree null-conic restrictionsfO/8 andfI. Thus every polynomial reparametrization is excluded,with original matrix degrees8degp and12degp. Harmonic decomposition and Molien dimension1 close all minimal-real-T-invariant seeds up to real affine change.
essential_boundaries: Global proper-cycle gluing,embedded resolution and analytic estimates are INTERNAL WRITTEN,not certified by the selected symbolic checker or by the exact local scope of Malgranges paper.
Properness,holomorphic volume over every finite fibre and isolated critical points are proved for the smooth-leading quadric model;they are not automatic for arbitrary affine maps.
The general quadric threshold isD>=N. Minimal degree and a smooth divisor as a SCHEME are essential. Repeated leading components fail the hypothesis.
A polynomial composition typically has repeated leading divisor;the conclusion forC[F] uses the proper model ofF and the root trace,not a fresh smooth-leading test ofp(F).

Singular leading divisor is necessary,not sufficient,for purity and says nothing by itself about failure. Some degree systems have no smooth-leading member;nonempty invariant strata are proved only in the stated24k/60k families.
Minimal-real-T-invariant seed closure is not closure of all full matrix-degree8/12 phases. The previous product seed has repeated null-conic zeros and uses its different hypergeometric proof.

Both exceptional MZ decisions remainOPEN;full non-T-invariant thin phases and image-interior marked safety remain inside the remaining singular-leading architecture. All earlier graph,marker,degree and Gaussian radial results are retained.
